title: Canonical Roos triangle of a completed-coefficient derived tower
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W, and the auxiliary datum D with l different from D.p as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. For any derived inverse system X of completed-coefficient sheaves in [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], the actual right-derived tower limit admits a Roos distinguished triangle [def-weil-derived-limit] whose first arrow is the product lift of coefficientConstantTowerProjection and whose successor maps are normalizedDVRTowerTransition. The countable product needed in this assertion exists.

source.place: Integral coefficient clause: derived inverse limits of compatible finite reductions; Roos computation as in Stacks Tags 0941, 079P, 0BK6 and 0BK7.

proof.text: Exact countable products on the small pro-etale site give countable AB4-star for completed-coefficient sheaves and the specified products of derived objects. Grothendieck abelianness gives enough injectives and K-injective resolutions.

Represent X by a simultaneous K-injective complex I of inverse systems. The degreewise limit complex and its evaluation projections form a limit cone, as can be checked degreewise. Apply the proved canonical tower-limit triangle to this cone.

Transport the triangle along the right-derived limit comparison and the evaluation comparison isomorphisms, then along the chosen isomorphism Q(I) with X. Product extensionality and naturality identify the second arrow with the successor endomorphism. The defining normalization of coefficientConstantTowerProjection on K-injective representatives identifies the first arrow with its stated product lift. Transport distinguishedness along this triangle isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientConstantTower_roos
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{t})
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (X : coefficientSequenceRestrictedDerived l E W) :
    ∃ hp : HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E W n).obj X),
      letI := hp
      ∃ δ, IsDerivedLimitTriangle
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E W D hl n.le_succ).app X)
        ((coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E W).obj X)
        (Pi.lift (fun n : ℕ ↦ (coefficientConstantTowerProjection l E W n).app X)) δ
